name: field-help-panel
title: Field help panel
description: A side panel of help that follows the field in focus: why we ask, an example and what happens next, beside the form on desktop and under the field on a phone.
docs: Pass help (field id to { title, body, example?, next?, link? }), the form as children and defaultId, the key of the general note. An element in the form with a data-help-id that is a key of help feeds the panel while the focus is in it: put it on the field or on the wrapper of its label, control and hint (FormField takes it as a prop). Below 1024px the help's bar goes last inside that element, so a wrapper wants a block or grid layout. On nothing with help the panel shows help[defaultId], which may be a field too. Changes cross-fade, instantly under reduced motion. Each field keeps its short hint in aria-describedby and the panel is a labelled complementary region, never a live region, so nothing depends on seeing it. Pin (aria-pressed) stops it changing while someone reads. From 1024px it is a sticky column (panelClassName moves where it sticks). Below that the column becomes two kinds of one-line bar: the general note above the form, and the help of the field in focus, put inside that field under its hint. Nothing above a field moves when it takes the focus, the bar stays under the last field you were in (also when the focus goes to a button), and a bar that is open stays open where it is when the focus moves on. A list that a field opens, a Select or a date picker, keeps the help on that field. In a row of fields give the row items-start, so an open bar does not stretch its neighbour. labels, headingLevel.
